Add typed CodeOn activity event catalog (#137)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-34
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - Add a closed `IssueActivityEventKind` catalog covering all 36 SQL-constrained source events.
    - Decode existing `change_context` payloads into strict typed contexts and return mapped, intentionally non-notifiable, or schema-drift outcomes with source audit identity.
    - Project `issue.execution_updated` into 13 stable route event names with bounded semantic content, facts, links, and severity.
    - Add catalog completeness, payload contract, execution, attention, drift-safety tests, and update tracker documentation.
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker -- --test-threads=1`
    - `cargo fmt --all --check`
    - `cargo clippy -p codeon-tracker --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
    
    ## Notes
    
    - Routes, delivery, HTTP, config, and event producers remain unchanged.
    - OpenWiki generation could not complete because `/root/.openwiki` is read-only; the owning OpenWiki page was aligned manually with the maintained specification.
